comment: The deck editor's built-in templates (Issue #226). kind is 'deck' (a whole starting deck) or 'slide' (one slide's layout, inserted after the slide you are on). 'then' opens the picture or video dialog straight after a slide template goes in. An administrator can hide any of these on a server; the files themselves stay as they are.

templates.title: Lecture
templates.description: Title, today's plan, a section, a build, a question for the room and a summary.

templates.title: Discussion or seminar
templates.description: A reading, three prompts with time for each, and a wrap-up.

templates.title: Short talk
templates.description: Five slides: a title, three points and thanks.

templates.title: Title slide
templates.description: A big centred title with a subtitle.

templates.title: Section divider
templates.description: Starts a new part of the lecture.

templates.title: Build list
templates.description: Bullets revealed one at a time.

templates.title: Two columns
templates.description: Side by side: compare, contrast, before and after.

templates.title: Picture and caption
templates.description: A picture on the right, the words on the left.

templates.title: Video slide
templates.description: A video, played from the controller.

templates.title: Quote
templates.description: A quotation and who said it.

templates.title: Question for the room
